title: Site map canvas: React Flow 12 or headless d3
context: Rebuilding the Site map canvas (post-#466). Research verdict: @xyflow/react 12 is MIT, ~61KB gzip marginal + 19KB CSS, nodes are React/Tailwind components, ships minimap/fitView/animated viewport flights/dark mode, active (12.11.3, React 19 support). Headless d3 stack (d3-force/zoom/hierarchy/selection, ISC, ~26KB) gives full control but we own 1-2k LOC of pan/zoom, minimap, culling, hit-testing before the first delightful pixel.
rationale: Owner locked via tray 2026-08-18: React Flow 12 wins on MIT license, React/Tailwind component nodes, built-in minimap/fitView/camera flights, and battle-tested gesture handling; d3 path costs 1-2k LOC of owned infrastructure for ~70KB savings.
